home.badge: Dedicated Platform for the Pal (Gadaria) Community
home.heroSubtitle: The high-trust matrimony platform built exclusively for the Pal community. Your phone number and private biodata are never exposed until both parties explicitly agree.
home.card1Desc: Phone numbers, emails, and residential addresses are never displayed in discovery or search results. All private data is encrypted.
home.card2Desc: Contact details are exchanged only after both parties independently approve the request. Payment never overrides consent.
home.card3Desc: Exported biodata PDFs carry a tamper-evident digital watermark with the recipient's unique ID to prevent unauthorized distribution.
home.stepsSubtitle: A dignified, simple, and completely secure matrimonial process.
home.step1Desc: Verify mobile and email securely. Underage profiles under 18 years are rejected automatically.
home.step2Desc: Add education, profession, family background, and private photos with visibility controls.
home.step3Desc: Manual review of selfie and profile photo by our moderation team to issue genuine verification badges.
home.step4Desc: Send interests, chat after mutual consent, and release contact numbers only when both sides are satisfied.
home.communityCalloutTitle: For the Community, By the Community
home.communityCalloutDesc: Honoring Pal community traditions while providing modern privacy standards. Managed by candidates or trusted family guardians.
